notes: Lower CPU use: a sync wait that spun the CPU now sleeps, item search no longer re-sorts on every row, and the repaint timer no longer touches the window from a background thread. Also restart-safe: the Plugin Hub can now restart it every 10 minutes (change or turn off on the hub's Diagnostics page) so long sessions stay smooth, and settings and progress carry over. Settings files are now saved safely, so a crash can no longer reset them.
